task_completion.description: The abdominal CT volume (amos_0001) is loaded into the 3D Slicer viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: 3D Slicer interface showing axial, sagittal, and coronal slices of an abdominal CT scan.

task_completion.description: The agent performs a diameter measurement at the intrahepatic level of the IVC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A ruler or markup line tool placed across the IVC in a slice where the liver is visible, with a measurement value displayed near 22.0 mm.

task_completion.description: The agent performs a diameter measurement at the infrarenal level of the IVC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A ruler or markup line tool placed across the IVC in a slice below the renal veins, with a measurement value displayed near 18.0 mm.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurement markups to the specified JSON file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog or terminal command showing the path ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/ivc_measurements.mrk.json.

task_completion.description: The agent creates the final report JSON with all required clinical fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing ivc_report.json with fields: intrahepatic_diameter_mm, infrarenal_diameter_mm, classification, morphology, and clinical_interpretation.

task_completion.description: The reported values in the JSON match the measurements taken in the GUI.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The values in the final report (e.g., 22.0 and 18.0) match the labels seen on the 3D Slicer canvas during the measurement steps.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI tools to measure rather than just writing a file manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor or active markup tools interacting with the CT slices in the Slicer interface.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the ground truth values into a file without opening the image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the CT scan being navigated (scrolling through slices) before the report is generated.

integrity.description: The agent used the Markups module or Ruler tool within Slicer.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Slicer 'Markups' or 'Data' module panel is visible and populated with measurement nodes.
